readout_other: Stroop task (Stroop effect, response time, accuracy); finger-tapping frequency by accelerometer
direction_notes: Stroop effect decreased after TUS versus sham (43.87 vs 54.55 ms, p = 0.05), significant in the multifocal group only; no effect on finger tapping or accuracy. Protocol was expected to be inhibitory.
safety_notes: Questionnaire after each session: minimal mild side effects (jaw muscle tightness most common), no significant TUS versus sham differences; simulated brain temperature rise 0.2-0.61 °C.

timing.protocol_description: Unifocal: one focus for 120 s; multifocal: electronic steering through 7 foci for 30 s each (210 s total); 10% duty cycle, 100 Hz PRF, 25% ramping (12.5% up and down) within each burst; delivered once per session.

source_quotes.n_subjects: 28 participants underwent TUS or sham stimulation
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: One session consisted of real ultrasound delivery (TUS session), and the other involved no energy delivery (sham session).
